run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum index sum among all rotations of a given array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify correct maximum rotation index sum results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use an O(n) approach instead of the current O(n squared) brute force
create_f_filled: create an optimized f_filled function that matches f_gold output using linear time complexity
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the maximum sum of index times value across all array rotations
